items.prompt: A clean instrumented run establishes what?

options.text: All conceivable paths and dependencies are certified
options.why: Coverage is finite and instrumentation has scope.

options.text: Financial units and authentication are proven
No concurrency error can exist anywhere
options.why: These sanitizers do not establish that.

options.text: No enabled diagnostic fired on the recorded executed paths

items.explanation: Clean local instrumentation is useful bounded evidence, not a universal proof.
